text:
I'd be happy to help you with your order! Since you don't remember your email, I can look you up using your name and zip code instead.

Could you please provide me with:
- Your first name
- Your last name  
- Your zip code

Once I have this information, I can find your account and help you with your order.
zh:
我很乐意帮助你处理订单！由于你记不住电子邮件，我可以用你的名字和邮政编码来查找你。

你能提供给我以下信息吗：
- 你的名字
- 你的姓氏  
- 你的邮政编码

一旦我有了这些信息，我就能找到你的账户并帮助你处理订单。
